own_findings.evidence: Worked TP=8 example: with a KV budget per rank of 436 ÷ 8 = 54.5 GB and 17.5 concurrent requests, a rank holds 17.5 + 8 + 54.48 = 79.98 GB = 99.97% of an 80 GB rank, so the aggregate 17.5 is a hard ceiling — exactly full, with zero per-rank headroom — not a comfortable operating point.
own_findings.issue: The unlabeled “17.5” in the sum is weights per rank in GB, while the immediately preceding “17.5” denotes concurrent requests, creating an ambiguous reused quantity.
own_findings.fix_instruction: Rewrite the sum with unit labels, e.g. “17.5 GB weights + 8 GB runtime + 54.48 GB KV = 79.98 GB.”
